problem: Ticket FIX-730 asks about second runs, recurring failures, and failure reports. The CLI repo provides commands for creating reruns (hlx tickets rerun, hlx tickets continue) and displaying run status/history. It is a context-only repo for this ticket — the CLI is an interface to the server's run management, not the source of run/failure behavior.

files.why: CLI command for triggering reruns: POST /api/tickets/{id}/rerun. Creates new run with parentRunId.
CLI command for continuing a run: POST /api/tickets/{id}/rerun with continuationContext. Same endpoint as rerun.
Displays ticket details including all runs with ID, status, startedAt, finishedAt.
HTTP client with retry logic: max 3 attempts, retryable status codes (429, 500, 502, 503, 504), exponential backoff.

facts: Rerun and continue commands both POST to /api/tickets/{id}/rerun. Continue passes additional continuationContext field.
CLI HTTP client retries on 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 with exponential backoff (max 3 attempts).
Terminal statuses for display: failed, error, cancelled, completed, succeeded.
No database or ORM. CLI is a REST API client to helix-global-server.
Quality gates: npm run build (tsc), npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run test (typecheck + node tests).
unknowns: The ticket does not reference any CLI-specific behavior or bug.
